places.name: Chennai
places.description: The capital city of Tamil Nadu, known for its beaches, temples, and historic sites.

places.name: Mahabalipuram
places.description: A historic town famous for its rock-cut temples and shore temples.

places.name: Madurai
places.description: An ancient city known for the Meenakshi Amman Temple.

places.name: Rameswaram
places.description: A holy island town known for the Ramanathaswamy Temple.

places.name: Kanyakumari
places.description: The southernmost tip of India, famous for its sunrises and sunsets.

places.name: Ooty
places.description: A popular hill station in the Nilgiri Hills.
transportation: Mettupalayam Railway Station (for the toy train)

places.name: Kodaikanal
places.description: A hill station known as the "Princess of Hill Stations".

places.name: Thanjavur
places.description: A city famous for the Brihadeeswarar Temple and Thanjavur paintings.

places.name: Hampi
places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site with ancient temples and ruins (located in nearby Karnataka, but a popular trip from Tamil Nadu).

places.name: Pondicherry
places.description: A Union Territory with a strong French influence, known for its beaches and colonial architecture.

travel_tips: Carry a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen, especially during the summer.
Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water.
Dress modestly when visiting temples and other religious sites.
Bargain with shopkeepers, especially in tourist areas.
Be aware of your surroundings and keep your valuables safe.
safety_advice: Avoid traveling alone at night, especially in isolated areas.
Do not accept food or drinks from strangers.
Keep a copy of your important documents, such as your passport and visa.
In case of an emergency, dial the appropriate emergency number.
